title: Logging a fuel fill
description: Record fills to learn your real fuel consumption.

steps.text: Open the Log tab and tap Fuel / Add Fill.
Enter litres or gallons and the price.
Add the odometer or hour reading if you have it.
Save. AftLog learns your real km/L and range.

tips: Consistent fill logs make the fuel-range estimate accurate.
Use GPS trips for the best accuracy.
affects: Season stats, Year in Review, and the fuel-range brain.
examples: A fill at 220 km with the price.
A top-up with the pump reading.
